gloss: crystalline body; crystal; lens of the eye

definitions.explanation: A solid in which atoms or molecules are arranged in a regular, repeating pattern. Used in science and materials contexts.
The transparent, biconvex structure in the eye that helps focus light on the retina. Also called {水晶体|すいしょうたい}.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}の{結晶体|けっしょうたい}は{六角形|ろっかくけい}をしている。
examples.english: Snow crystals have a hexagonal shape.

examples.japanese: ダイヤモンドは{炭素|たんそ}の{結晶体|けっしょうたい}である。
examples.english: A diamond is a crystalline body of carbon.

examples.japanese: この{鉱物|こうぶつ}は{美|うつく}しい{結晶体|けっしょうたい}を{形成|けいせい}する。
{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{結晶体|けっしょうたい}が{濁|にご}ると{白内障|はくないしょう}になる。
examples.english: When the crystalline lens becomes cloudy with age, it leads to cataracts.

examples.japanese: {結晶体|けっしょうたい}は{光|ひかり}を{屈折|くっせつ}させて{網膜|もうまく}に{像|ぞう}を{結|むす}ぶ。
examples.english: The crystalline lens refracts light to form an image on the retina.

examples.japanese: {白内障|はくないしょう}の{手術|しゅじゅつ}では、{濁|にご}った{結晶体|けっしょうたい}を{人工|じんこう}レンズに{置|お}き{換|か}える。
examples.english: In cataract surgery, the clouded crystalline lens is replaced with an artificial lens.

notes:
Composed of {結晶|けっしょう} (crystal) and {体|たい} (body/object). Has both a general scientific meaning and a specific anatomical meaning.

For the eye (sense 2), {水晶体|すいしょうたい} is the more standard medical term. {結晶体|けっしょうたい} is sometimes used as a simpler alternative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結晶体|けっしょうたい}の{構造|こうぞう}: crystal structure
- {結晶体|けっしょうたい}を{形成|けいせい}する: to form a crystal
- {結晶体|けっしょうたい}が{濁|にご}る: the lens becomes cloudy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {結晶|けっしょう}: crystal — the more common general term
- {水晶体|すいしょうたい}: crystalline lens — the standard anatomical term
- {鉱物|こうぶつ}: mineral — a broader category
